messages:
katie: Quick sync — we need a dependency map tying vendor delivery + embargo windows to marketplace gating and SI lab readiness for H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Can folks confirm EOW? @raj @oliver

raj: Yep. I have two vendor decks with different dates, need the source-of-truth.

oliver: putting a quick sketch in here for visibility:
```
H100: vendor tentative ship 2026-02-01 -> limited carrier q1
H200: vendor tentative ship 2026-05-15 -> embargo pending
B200: GA 2026-04-10 (confirmed)
MI300: rolling shipments from 2026-06 (region phased)
Gaudi: APAC heavy wave Jul-Aug 2026 (EU/NA earlier/later depending on infra)
```

nora: marketplace gating checklist (short): SKU mapping, firmware tag, driver matrix, region opt-in flag, price tier, legal embargo note, observability testing signoff.

chris: SI perspective — integrators need lab images, kernel patches, and a named vendor firmware contact. Also we need a two-week buffer to validate NLB/SCALING in our staging clusters.

bob-nvidia: Vendor update: H200 firmware v2.1 targeted for 2026-05-01. We expect an embargo tied to the joint announcement — working on exact embargo lift date.

katie: Important — do not publish marketplace SKUs before vendor embargo lifts. Proposing: marketplace soft-launch = embargo_lift + 14 days. Thoughts?

raj: Action items: 1) Vendor to confirm firm delivery + embargo dates; 2) Marketplace to produce blocking checklist (firmware, drivers, regions); 3) SI to reserve lab slots and validate images.

oliver: example marketplace flag snippet for tracking:
```
{
  "sku": "redwood-h200-1",
  "region": ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"],
  "firmware_tag": "nv_f2.1",
  "embargo_until": "2026-05-10"
}
```

nora: ack — I'll draft the gating checklist and open a PR to the marketplace repo with required test steps and a small checklist for QA.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please add embargo dates and vendor contacts to https://go/repo/marketplace-tracking (team owners will be pinged automatically).

chris: Press coordination question — if Gaudi APAC wave overlaps MI300 global, we should stagger to avoid cross-press noise. Can we define preferred order?

katie: My take: MI300 global first, then Gaudi APAC with a 2-week offset. That reduces overlap and eases capacity ramp. Any objections?

bob-nvidia: Vendor ok with staggering. We will confirm ship-days by EOD tomorrow.

oliver: I'll consolidate these notes into a dependency map doc and push to the partnerships drive. ETA tomorrow 11am PT.

nora: Thanks — looping SI partner in for scheduling. @chris please start booking lab slots based on tentative dates.

chris: On it — tentative lab booking 2026-05-20 -> 2026-05-27. Will update when vendor confirms shipment windows.

katie: Great work team, thanks :thumbsup: — once vendor confirms dates we'll lock gating checklist and set marketplace soft-launch windows.
